content.title: Buffy’s New Era: What to Expect From the Hulu Reboot!
content.text: Buffy the Vampire Slayer is officially returning — and this time, the dead might be coming with it! In this video, we break down the latest updates on Hulu’s upcoming Buffy the Vampire Slayer reboot/sequel, including shocking quotes from Sarah Michelle Gellar about resurrecting beloved characters, and Charisma Carpenter's passionate plea to return as Cordelia Chase. We’ll explore what a lighter tone means for the new series, how dead characters like Anya, Tara, and possibly even Cordelia could return, and why this reboot could be the redemption arc fans have been waiting nearly 20 years for. Plus: We spotlight Charisma Carpenter’s new Buffy/Angel rewatch podcast The Bitch Is Back and what it means for Cordelia’s legacy in the Buffyverse. Will Cordelia Chase finally get justice? Can Buffy resurrect the dead — and should she? Join us for all the hype, theories, and news surrounding the Buffy reboot! 👍 Like | 💬 Comment | 🔔 Subscribe for all your Buffyverse updates!
